why.en: Shows your link-local fe80:: address and any global address built by SLAAC.
why.hinglish: Tumhara link-local fe80:: address aur SLAAC se bana koi bhi global address dikhata hai.

expect.en: An fe80:: link-local address, and if your network offers IPv6 a global address starting with 2xxx: or 3xxx:. If you only see fe80::, your network has no IPv6. On macOS use ifconfig | grep inet6.
expect.hinglish: Ek fe80:: link-local address, aur agar tumhara network IPv6 deta hai to 2xxx: ya 3xxx: se shuru hone wala global address. Agar sirf fe80:: dikhe to tumhare network par IPv6 nahi hai. macOS par ifconfig | grep inet6 use karo.

why.en: This is IPv6's replacement for the ARP cache, filled by Neighbor Solicitation and Advertisement.
why.hinglish: Yeh ARP cache ki IPv6 wali jagah hai, jo Neighbor Solicitation aur Advertisement se bharti hai.

expect.en: Entries mapping IPv6 addresses (such as your router's fe80:: address) to MAC addresses with a state like REACHABLE or STALE. Contents vary; on macOS use ndp -an.
expect.hinglish: IPv6 addresses (jaise tumhare router ka fe80:: address) ko MAC addresses se map karti entries, REACHABLE ya STALE jaise state ke saath. Contents alag hote hain; macOS par ndp -an use karo.

title.hinglish: Ek IPv6 address ko ping karo

why.en: Sends ICMPv6 Echo Request and Reply (types 128 and 129) to Google's public DNS.
why.hinglish: Google ke public DNS ko ICMPv6 Echo Request aur Reply (types 128 aur 129) bhejta hai.

expect.en: Three replies with times if your network has working IPv6; otherwise an error such as 'General failure' or 'Network is unreachable'. On macOS use ping6.
expect.hinglish: Agar tumhare network par IPv6 chal raha hai to times ke saath teen replies; warna 'General failure' ya 'Network is unreachable' jaisa error. macOS par ping6 use karo.

title.en: Filter Neighbor Discovery in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein Neighbor Discovery filter karo

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark to see the RS, RA, NS and NA messages.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur RS, RA, NS aur NA messages dekho.

expect.en: Router Solicitation (133), Router Advertisement (134), Neighbor Solicitation (135) and Neighbor Advertisement (136) packets, all with hop limit 255.
expect.hinglish: Router Solicitation (133), Router Advertisement (134), Neighbor Solicitation (135) aur Neighbor Advertisement (136) packets, sab hop limit 255 ke saath.
